cases.name: aliased external extras retain skipped prefixes and scanner state
cases.listing:
(grammar (start source))
(extra (alias hidden_fragment (ref drop)))
(scanner endings (tokens drop) (operations (if (equal (depth pending) (integer 0)) (then fail)) (while (next (literal %20)) (do (skip (literal %20)))) (consume (literal %C3%A9%F0%9F%98%80)) (pop pending) (emit drop)))
(rule opening token (literal %5B) (action (push pending (integer 1))))
(rule source normal (seq (ref opening) (predicate (literal x) (equal (depth pending) (integer 0)))))

cases.name: aliased composite extras retain their fields and child spans
cases.listing:
(grammar (start document) (matching longest))
(extra (alias renamed_note (ref note)))
(extra (literal %20))
(rule note normal (seq (literal %5B) (capture labeled words (token (literal x))) (literal %5D)))
(rule document normal (literal z))

cases.name: silent extra aliases retain source identity when syntax retakes their token
cases.listing:
(grammar (start document) (matching longest))
(extra (alias renamed_break (ref padding)))
(rule padding silent (literal %0A))
(rule document normal (seq (token (literal %0A)) (literal x)))

cases.name: anonymous extra aliases remain distinct from significant anonymous syntax
cases.listing:
(grammar (start document) (matching longest))
(extra (alias unnamed_token (ref padding)))
(rule padding silent (literal %0A))
(rule document normal (seq (alias unnamed_token (token (literal %3B))) (literal x)))
